changelog: - **SSO**: reject `oidc` as a tenant SSO provider at the write boundary (`validateSsoConfig`), and treat an already-stored OIDC config as inactive (`isSsoActive`) — the login route only builds SAML requests, so saving OIDC previously reported success and locked the tenant out. The admin provider selector now shows OIDC disabled ("coming soon").

en: Enterprise SSO now refuses OIDC instead of silently saving a configuration that would lock a tenant out — SAML is the supported provider, OIDC is marked coming soon.
tr: Kurumsal SSO artık OIDC'yi sessizce kaydedip kiracıyı girişten kilitlemek yerine reddediyor — desteklenen sağlayıcı SAML, OIDC "yakında" olarak işaretlendi.
de: Enterprise-SSO lehnt OIDC jetzt ab, statt eine Konfiguration zu speichern, die einen Mandanten aussperrt — unterstützt wird SAML, OIDC ist als "demnächst" markiert.
